nodes.label: CPCB National AQI
nodes.rationale: Confirmed CPCB National AQI (key cpcb_in, schema aqi_standard.v1). 24h average. Hazard label Very Poor at 121 µg/m³ copied from HAZARD_THRESHOLD_UGM3. Bands copied from the existing CPCB_PM25_BANDS table.

nodes.label: Very Poor hazard threshold (121 µg/m³)
nodes.rationale: Served hazard label is Very Poor once PM2.5 reaches 121.0 µg/m³. Threshold copied from HAZARD_THRESHOLD_UGM3.

nodes.label: NSW Air Quality Categories
nodes.rationale: Unconfirmed placeholder (key au_nsw_aqc). Source URL, averaging, hazard label, threshold, and bands are empty. Confirm NSW categories, thresholds, and averaging from the government source before any label is served.

nodes.label: Singapore NEA
nodes.rationale: Unconfirmed placeholder (key sg_nea). Confirm the NEA index, averaging period, and official band table before any label is served.

nodes.label: Bushfire smoke
nodes.rationale: Source class bushfire. Smoke from bushfires, often lofted and carried toward cities. Seasonal months 10–2 are a setting to confirm from NSW fire climatology.

nodes.label: Bushfire season (Oct–Feb)
nodes.rationale: Feature is_bushfire_season for months 10, 11, 12, 1, 2. Marked as a setting to confirm from NSW fire climatology.

nodes.label: Bushfire plume defaults
nodes.rationale: Lofted release: 10m weight 0.2, 100m weight 0.8. Horizons 1, 3, 6, 12, 24, and 48 hours.

nodes.label: Crop-residue burning
nodes.rationale: Source class crop_residue_burning. Smoke from crop-residue fires carried by near-surface wind. Seasonal months 4, 5, 10, 11 must be confirmed against regional climatology before showing to users.

nodes.label: Stubble season (Apr–May, Oct–Nov)
nodes.rationale: Feature is_stubble_season for months 4, 5, 10, 11.

nodes.label: Crop-residue plume defaults
nodes.rationale: Near-surface release: 10m weight 0.8, 100m weight 0.2. Horizons 1, 3, 6, 12, and 24 hours.

nodes.label: FIRMS detections on cropland in season
Dust
nodes.rationale: Source class dust. Wind-blown dust, not a fire plume. Seasonal months 4, 5, 6 must be confirmed before showing to users.

nodes.label: Dust season (Apr–Jun)
nodes.rationale: Feature is_dust_season for months 4, 5, 6.

nodes.label: Dust plume defaults
nodes.rationale: Near-surface release: 10m weight 0.9, 100m weight 0.1. Horizons 1, 3, 6, and 12 hours.

nodes.label: Transboundary haze
nodes.rationale: Source class peat_and_forest_fire. Smoke from vegetation and peat fires carried across borders by regional winds. Seasonal months 8, 9, 10 are a setting to confirm from regional climatology.

nodes.label: Haze season (Aug–Oct)
nodes.rationale: Feature is_haze_season for months 8, 9, 10.

nodes.label: Transboundary haze plume defaults
nodes.rationale: Lofted release: 10m weight 0.3, 100m weight 0.7. Horizons 1, 3, 6, 12, 24, and 48 hours.

nodes.label: Upwind fire radiative power on back trajectory
Urban pollution
nodes.rationale: Source class urban_combustion. Urban combustion under low wind. No plume is run for this profile: horizons_hours is empty and release_level_weights are omitted.

nodes.label: Urban season (year-round)
nodes.rationale: Feature is_urban_season covers months 1 through 12.

nodes.label: CPCB CAAQMS
nodes.rationale: connector_id cpcb_caaqms version 1.0.0, provider CPCB, data type air_quality, HTTPS, API key. Polls every 900 seconds. Realtime and historical.

nodes.label: FIRMS VIIRS
nodes.rationale: connector_id firms_viirs version 1.0.0, provider NASA, data type active_fire, HTTPS, API key. Polls every 900 seconds. Realtime, historical, and spatial query.

nodes.label: IMD weather
nodes.rationale: connector_id imd_weather version 1.0.0, provider IMD, data type weather, HTTPS, API key. Polls every 3600 seconds. Realtime and historical.

nodes.label: OpenAQ
nodes.rationale: connector_id openaq, provider OpenAQ, air quality, API key via AEROPULSE_OPENAQ_API_KEY sent as the X-API-Key header. Polls every 900 seconds. live_verified is false. Only pm25 and pm10 are ingested because gas sensors often report ppm and would corrupt the fused vector. Values older than AEROPULSE_CONNECTOR_MAX_OBSERVATION_AGE_HOURS are dropped. monitor=true limits discovery to reference-grade government monitors; in India those are CPCB CAAQMS, and other countries use the local equivalent. OpenAQ aggregates upstream networks, each with its own licence.

nodes.label: Open-Meteo
nodes.rationale: connector_id openmeteo, provider Open-Meteo, air quality and weather, anonymous public API, polls every 3600 seconds, live_verified true. Air quality values are CAMS-derived model output and are a background prior, never CPCB ground truth. aerosol_optical_depth is dimensionless and is never mapped to surface PM2.5. Non-commercial use is CC-BY-4.0; commercial deployment needs review. Attribution: Weather and air quality data by Open-Meteo.com.
